name: Zhihu video

disclosure.zh: 含 AI 内容时，在「发布设置 → 创作声明」里选「包含 AI 辅助创作」。标题必填（≤ 30 字），简介 ≤ 300 字；话题在单独的「话题」栏里选，不写 #。站外导流会失去优质视频资格。
disclosure.en: If AI was used, choose 发布设置 → 创作声明 → 包含AI辅助创作. Title required (<= 30), intro <= 300; topics go in the separate topic field (no #). Off-site links cost the 优质 status.

guide.zh: 打开上传视频页，应用放入视频、填好标题和简介。领域、话题、原创 / 转载、是否投稿到问题由你选，再点「发布」。
guide.en: On the upload page the app adds the video and types the title and intro. Pick the field (领域), topics, original / repost and whether to answer a question, then press Publish yourself.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
Upload URL is the convention (no source confirmed it); 创作中心 → 上传视频 is the documented path.
